title: Pharaonic guide front matter
description: Metadata at the top of every guides/{category}/{slug}/index.md file.

title.description: Page title. The website renders it as the page heading, so the body does not repeat it.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Must equal the guide's directory name.

description.description: Plain-text summary of what the reader will learn. 120-160 characters is recommended.

category.description: Ecosystem the guide belongs to. Must equal the guide's parent directory name.

related_packages.description: Pharaonic package slugs (php-diff), not Composer names (pharaonic/php-diff).

updated_at.description: Last meaningful content update. Must not be earlier than published_at.

status.description: Only published guides are shown on pharaonic.dev in production.

image.description: Cover image, relative to the guide directory.

canonical.description: Only for content first published elsewhere. Omit it to use the pharaonic.dev URL.

date.description: A quoted YYYY-MM-DD string. Unquoted YAML dates are parsed as timestamps.
